_about: W911 (FU-399) - /api/v1/heartbeat/status, the one answer HeartbeatMonitor reads, captured from the app's own route on an empty store: before any beat, and after one real beat (POST /api/v1/heartbeat/beat). HeartbeatMonitor.test.tsx mounts the page against them.

before.auto_metabolic_basis: runtime only: set through /heartbeat/configure and NOT persisted, so a restart returns it to off
before.circadian_to_atp_basis: runtime only, default OFF (Owner ruling 2026-10-07): when on, the phase's intensity (1.0/0.7/0.5/0.3) is the ATP production efficiency; a restart returns it to off

evolution_auto_apply.consumer: organism.heartbeat applies CCA-APPROVED evolution proposals each beat
evolution_auto_apply.effect_when_off: approved evolution proposals are never applied; they wait
evolution_auto_apply.how_to_change: submit a change request to the CCA at /change-control
evolution_auto_apply.why_not_a_toggle: the arms-length approval it sits behind is the point

before.evolve_pacing: Self-improve is attempted once every 30 beats, and only in a maintenance phase; 0 beat(s) have passed since the last attempt

immune_quarantine.basis: not engaged - self-healing probes open circuits

before.interval_basis: interval_seconds is the BASE; the loop waits base / phase intensity, which is effective_interval_seconds for the current phase and changes when the phase does
before.last_realisation_measure: API surface coverage, not delivery - see /api/v1/plan/state
before.metabolic_basis: the metabolic cycle has not run on this process, so there is no outcome to report — the loop is paced and OFF by default, and this is not a withheld emission
before.note: Continuous circadian autonomy — cheap pulse every beat; expensive cognition opt-in + paced.

this layer has NEVER been refreshed, which is not the same as refreshed long ago - there is no previous weekly refresh to measure from

recent.health_basis: NOT A MEASUREMENT - no call was observed in the immune window, so 1.0 is the absence of failures and not a reading of anything
recent.steps_failed_basis: steps attempted on this beat that raised, by name, cleared at the start of every beat so a failure never outlives the beat that had it. They are deliberately NOT in `actions`: an action is something the beat performed. Since W611 (FU-461) EVERY beat step's failure is recorded here, so an EMPTY steps_failed means no step raised. That includes a step that CAUGHT its own error and reports it in a field of its own (the four homeostatic responders, the cadence, the two reconciliations and the metabolic cycle): each is recorded here as well. One thing is not a step failure and is not here: a single unreadable ship record skipped while looking for stale bodies.
